verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Stripe pushes real-time data to a webhook endpoint when events happen in the account, and that webhook events can be used to monitor and handle subscription status transitions. A Stripe Billing PM also states that merchants can use their own webhooks instead of Stripe's default emails, which supports this as a real-world pattern. Missing for 10: detail on the event catalog and endpoint/event-type selection, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, and independent hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability.
